scope: Independent native-frame remeasurement supporting a labelled Practice Dummy health reconstruction

source.version_limit: Original live footage; exact client revision not established.

method.interval: 343.0–362.066667 s, continuous section of original retained video
method.measurement: First native frame with target mesh/nameplate absent to first native frame with mesh/nameplate present. Health overlay becoming fully bright is not the return boundary.
method.timestamp_uncertainty: Each transition lies between its recorded frame and the preceding frame (66.6667 ms). Interval difference has ±66.6667 ms quantization uncertainty. These are visible intervals, not recovered server timers.
method.images: Crops resized for inspection; nearest-neighbor montages explicitly named. No generated enhancement.

observations.value: Five single-round magazine decrements, 20→19→18→17→16→15, accompany five dummy disappearances; reserve remains 989.
Third hit red damage number reads 84 at 355.266667–355.466667; it is followed by disappearance after one spent rifle round.
Last hit appears 68; fourth appears 71. Compression makes these readings less certain, so neither is used as an exact HP bound.

The previous 100 HP analogue is poorly supported by repeated one-shot disappearance including the 84-damage cycle; footage does not distinguish a small fixed HP pool from scripted destruction on successful hit.
observations.unverified: No maxHP packet; no weapon of independently proven lower damage attacking this dummy; no original server script.

timing_summary.prior_correction: Previous audit missed 357.733333→358.866667 and used fully bright 351.8 instead of first visible 351.666667. The nominal 930 ms remains compatible as a rounded center; ±70 ms does not cover the visible sample variation.
timing_summary.unverified: Whether animation/network/server tick timing explains variable visible intervals; original nominal restore period.

alternative_videos.result: Retained Advancing 2of8 begins at Calling for Reinforcements, mission 1995, after the dummy lesson; no added evidence for mission 1992.
Retained Tutorial gameplay covers mission 1995/2 combat around Denzil’s Caldera; no added evidence for mission 1992.

lightning_limit.value: Original objectiveconversation (1992,9,2563,1,1), assignment 40853, cites text 21665: target the dummy and fire a lightning bolt. It does not explicitly require a destroying hit. The existing 362.067→362.133 cut omits this action.
lightning_limit.interpretation: Destroying-hit-only credit and reused reset timing remain inferences; no stronger observation recovered.

implementation.reasoning: Minimal positive integer HP reproduces repeated single-hit destruction through the existing damage system. Exact original HP is unknown. Assuming normal damage-driven destruction with no concurrent damage or forced script, the clear 84-damage cycle would bound the then-current health at 84, not identify maximum HP. The seeded 1 HP is not an original recovered value.
implementation.unchanged: Target Dummy 198653 retains 100 HP; its Lightning scene is absent. Nominal 930 ms is retained for both; no custom destroy-on-hit mechanism is introduced.
